name: Oto Radio
description: A retro theme for podcasts, radio shows and audio series: a deep violet ground, cream type and one amber on-air light, Darker Grotesque headlines over Work Sans text. The header is a programme-guide masthead: a dateline with the on-air time and a pulsing “On air” lamp, a giant wordmark across the page, then the menu on a ruled bar with a tuning-scale edge. The home page is a broadcast log: after a cover with a tuning dial, the latest episodes stand as stops on a vertical amber timeline, each with its date, the episode number, running time, a waveform that plays when pointed at and a record sleeve whose vinyl slides out; then the running order of an hour, the two hosts and a listener's letter. The footer is led by the newsletter in a full-width amber band. With a numbered Episodes index with running times, Hosts with the crew, About with a week of making an episode as a timeline, show notes, a newsletter and contact. Episode numbers and running times are written once in each episode's listen bar; the on-air time, subscribe links, email addresses and social links are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the masthead wordmark, the menu, episode numbers, dates and the dial
